question: To whom and under what test condition is a particular teaching required to be given rather than withheld?
premises: A particular teaching is marked as something to be given.
It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient is to be one tested for the course of one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a test lasting one year.
uncertainties: The nature of the test itself is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
